diagnosis: v2 could leave its loop on one transient identity sample, recover on the immediate second sample, and then fall through to TERM without independently establishing that the deadline had arrived
fix: v3 records component and observed state, PGID, starttime and cmdline hash; confirms a mismatch after one second; treats recovery as recovery; and asserts current epoch is at or past the absolute deadline before TERM
independent_fallback: launcher GNU timeout --foreground TERM with kill-after 60 seconds remains active
